title: 5,300-year-old kidney stone the size of a grape found in Bronze Age man's burial near Black Sea
caption:
Archaeologists in Russia discovered a grape-sized kidney stone inside a 5,300-year-old burial. Chemical analysis reveals the Bronze Age cattle herder likely suffered from a chronic, painful infection for years.

Source: Livescience - 5,300-year-old kidney stone the size of a grape found in Bronze Age man's burial near Black Sea
